ratings_why.fun: Eggs hatching into Chicks that shove their hosts, and dormice waking fat from their jars, are moments you want to watch; the rules load keeps it from 8.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7: it is the only tribe that grows from the enemy's own units, timed by a visible mid-fight clock, so a tall enemy board feeds you instead of beating you.

verdict_why: One real gap to close: Asleep against other tribes' targeting is still only a proposal in the risks, not in the keyword.

points.text: Asleep says it can't be attacked, but not what happens to Mire, Quarry, Snap, Swoop or 'a random enemy' aimed at a sleeper. Put the risks' ruling (treat it as absent until it wakes) into the Asleep keyword.

Grand Horologe Ottilie Gugger now works, but her text is five clauses a player can't take in at a glance. Lead with the core, 'Your Start of Combat effects happen twice, at the first Hour instead', and move the edge cases to a rules tooltip.
Reed-Line Journeyman's second sentence covers all your Eggs, not just its own, which is easy to misread. Start it with 'Your Eggs:' so the reach is plain.

Nest-Box Dormouse only works if a Chick lands next to it, which the player steers only indirectly through slot choice. A line on the card or a nest-box marker on the empty slot would make the plan readable.
The fantasy comes through in play: placing eggs, the shove, the alarm. The screen must show Egg markers on enemy units with the Chick's stats, or the tribe's best moment will happen out of sight.

standouts.why: Little Gernegroß hides in the biggest enemy's nest and comes back huge to shove it; it is the cuckoo story in one card.
Old Unruh asleep since autumn, marked present, and woken only by the alarm as the last defender reads at once and plays like the joke.
Mother Rohrsang is one short line that changes the whole tribe's number, and the foster mother doubling the chick's share is right.

weakest.why: Ottilie is the hardest card in the set to read; strong idea, wall of text.
First-Call Herald is a plain gold piece; the Hour is its only tie to the theme.
Frau Wechselbalg's Discover from the host's tribe is clever but abstract; the changeling fantasy shows only in the name.

flags.note: Readable only with study; check that players can tell which effects she delays and when they land.
Golden Hour-Keeper striking every attack with Door Cuckoo and Kasimir may flood the board with Eggs; the designer already asks for a sim.
With Little Gernegroß, Rohrsang gives him all of the biggest enemy's stats; golden Rohrsang makes every Chick a full copy.
